info.title: Onesa Mobile hardware pilot and operations API
info.description: Persistent prelaunch control plane for a physical hardware pilot, customer accounts and internal operations. Lab/production identity mode never enables mobile-network, satellite, payment or subscriber-registration effects. All responses use Cache-Control:no-store. Browser mutations require exact Origin/CSRF; native opaque bearer transport is separate. Domain request schemas are generated from the actual exported Zod schemas. JSON Schema does not express all time, ownership, secret-reference and cross-field workflow checks; operation descriptions define those runtime conditions. HTTP parser/transport failures before the application handler may close the connection without a JSON error. No arbitrary query strings, redirected business requests or client-supplied roles/owners are supported.

servers.description: Same-origin web reverse proxy; strips /api before reaching the backend.
Loopback isolated development API only; production public origin must use HTTPS.

X-Request-Id.description: Server-generated correlation identifier; contains no account credential.

Cache-Control.description: All responses are private to the request and are never cached.

Set-Cookie.description: Clear the flow cookie; web completion also sets the local opaque session cookie.

parameters.description: Authorization code delivered by the configured issuer.

parameters.description: BFF state; must match the presented flow cookie and stored unconsumed flow.

parameters.name: iss
parameters.description: Issuer response parameter, when provided by Portal.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Provider-denied flow; cannot issue a session.

get.description: The public proxy path is /api/v1/auth/onesa/callback and must be registered exactly in Portal; the API itself receives /v1/auth/onesa/callback after stripping /api. State, nonce, S256 and signed ID token are checked; current Mobile access/MFA is then obtained from live Portal /session. Web returns only to /account/ or /internal/. Native emits only a 60-second one-time handoff code bound to the native state/verifier; no session token appears in its URL.

parameters.description: Generate once for an intended business mutation, retain through uncertain retries, and replace when input changes. Scope is the authenticated subject. Cookie mutations require exact Origin and X-CSRF-Token; native bearer requests may omit both. Every business mutation requires Idempotency-Key. Existing records require their current positive revision; a stale revision returns 409 without applying the action. Identity and role are revalidated before business processing.
